title: Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR
abstract: arXiv:2610.13807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. translated_title: 错误率还不够：低资源语音识别中数据增强的代价
translated_abstract: 数据增强是低资源自动语音识别（ASR）的标准做法，但其收益几乎总是以总体错误率的形式报告，这使得一种方法为何有效、何时有效这一问题悬而未决。在四种低资源语言和英语的五种数据规模上，我们将两种修改现有音频的增强方法（速度扰动和SpecAugment）与两种修改文本转写并据此合成音频的方法进行交叉组合实验。我们在音素层面分析错误，发现这些方法以互补的方式发挥作用。SpecAugment带来最可靠的总体改进，但会增加声调和腭化错误，而基于文本的方法会引入辅音插入错误；两者结合使用时，各自能减少对方引入的错误。这种互补性是可以预测的：声调和腭化各自仅由单一声学属性标记，且在训练中出现频率最低（即最低训练暴露度），而基于文本的方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过音素级错误分析发现，低资源ASR中不同数据增强方法的收益与代价互补——SpecAugment虽总体改进最可靠但会加剧声调和腭化错误，基于文本的方法则引入辅音插入错误，两者结合可相互抵消缺陷，且这种互补性可由错误类型的声学属性与训练暴露度预测。
en_tdlr: Through phoneme-level error analysis, this paper shows that augmentation methods in low-resource ASR have complementary costs—SpecAugment gives the most reliable aggregate gains but increases tone and palatalization errors while text-based methods introduce consonant insertions—and combining them mitigates each other's weaknesses in a predictable way.
